title: main screens redesign phase two three

commit.merge_subject: merge: main screens redesign phase two three

description:
Modernize the main-app bottom navigation and give Projects/Settings the
shared header (owner request 2026-11-11d sections 4.5 and 21 Phase 3).
What changed and why:

- The four destinations keep their exact identities, labels and
  behavior; only the presentation modernizes. NavigationBar itself is
  stock M3, so the Monet selected/unselected colors, indicator pill,
  label alignment and spacing all continue to come from the dynamic
  scheme.
- Icon consistency: every destination now has a proper
  outlined/filled glyph pair instead of the cached-core stand-ins
  (PlayArrow for Library, ExitToApp for Exports) recorded as a
  deviation earlier. material-icons-extended is not in the offline
  Gradle cache, so the eight glyphs are vendored vector drawables
  (ic_nav_{library,projects,exports,settings}_{outlined,filled}),
  generated from Material Symbols geometry and verified offline; they
changed: feat: modernized bottom nav and headers
